variants.prompt:
Create a finished, art-directed BRAND IDENTITY PRESENTATION BOARD for Aarre, a browser extension for saving, curating and returning to interesting things on the web. This is an ORIGINAL complete identity direction, not an isolated app icon. Landscape 3:2 composition, high resolution, fully opaque background. The exact brand spelling is "Aarre" (capital A, lowercase arre). Make the logo, typography, colors, graphic language and product applications rigorously consistent across the board. Treat this like an award-caliber independent design studio's identity case study. Include an original, memorably simple standalone emblem which is also legible as a 24px extension icon, a prominent beautifully crafted wordmark, a compact color/type specimen, an applied editorial brand moment, and a credible desktop browser product application with a small right-edge floating product handle plus a compact save panel. Product panel should use concise English labels "Save to Aarre", "Title", "Collection", "Note", "Save". Aarre is an existing real name; do not invent a new brand name. Sparse intentional readable copy only. Absolutely no generic lightbulb, standard bookmark glyph, heart, cartoon diamond, glitter, faceted jewelry, AI sparkles, stock icon, system icon or derivative famous logo. No fake agency watermarks. No decorative explanatory paragraphs. The board itself must be beautifully designed, with sharp typography, deliberate scale contrast, confident proportions, generous but efficient spacing, finished print-quality details. No angled unreadable device mockups or piles of arbitrary merchandise. Show the digital product straight-on and clearly; this is a browser-based personal collection tool, not a banking dashboard. 
DIRECTION 01 — KEPT / QUIET EDITORIAL.
A warm contemporary literary identity, collected intelligence, tactile but not retro. Palette: creamy paper #F2EBD9, near-black brown #27231F, burnt vermilion #BC4934; use only these three main hues. A distinctive chunky yet elegant custom old-style serif Aarre wordmark with subtly sculpted terminals, a compelling lowercase double r rhythm. Invent a very simple asymmetric solid red folded folio / nested page emblem from two broad interlocking shapes and a single decisive counterform; NOT a standard bookmark outline. The emblem should be bold and iconic, like a publisher's imprint.
COMPOSITION: One very large cream editorial area on the left with the Aarre wordmark and exact headline "Worth keeping." Huge quiet type and a small vermilion emblem. On the right a clear cream/ink browser collection UI with editorial cards, a compact save panel and small right-edge extension handle carrying the same emblem. A horizontal lower band combines a vermilion full-bleed brand card with cream emblem, a precise serif/sans alphabet specimen, three flat palette squares, and a close-up app tile. Fine rules, handsome baseline alignments, faint natural uncoated paper grain in presentation surfaces only. Art direction should evoke a thoughtful cultural publisher adapted beautifully for a useful modern web tool. No jewel symbolism. No rustic craft or coffee-shop mockups. Refined real editorial restraint, not beige generic minimalism.

Keep copy sparse, exact main spelling, no gibberish filler, no extra fake brand names, no agency watermark, no device piles, no generic bookmark glyph, diamond, heart, AI sparkle, light bulb or stock system icon. A small beautifully aligned side panel holds an Aa specimen, color chips and app icon light/dark. Rounded geometry is quiet, not bubbly. Use restrained botanical textures only in editorial areas, clean readable UI. Expressive and original design-studio branding; green is luminous and alive, never generic corporate eco branding.
